description: This file defines a React functional component `Auth` for user authentication in a student attendance tracking app. It manages login state, handles login via local storage, and provides a user interface for login including demo credentials.

methods.name: saveToStorage
methods.description: Stores a key-value pair in the browser's local storage after serializing the value to JSON.

methods.name: loadFromStorage
methods.description: Retrieves a value from local storage by key, parsing it from JSON, returning a fallback if not found or parsing fails.

methods.name: Auth
methods.description: A React functional component that displays a login form, manages authentication state, and invokes a callback on successful login.

methods.name: handleLogin
methods.description: Handles form submission, verifies credentials against stored data or demo credentials, and calls `onAuth` upon success or sets an invalid flag.
